source: Reference answers from Claude Opus 5.5 (medium effort), answered blind. Each case was given exactly the system prompt, user message and output schema the gateway sends to a Messages API upstream (captured from the gateway at 75eed5c), then mapped back through the gateway itself (normalization, choice, score, confidence, 2-decimal rounding). The without_user_instructions answers come from a separate agent that never saw the user_instructions variant.

reasons.claim_handling: 640 USD is above the 500 cap, so a carrier investigation must come first; this is reversible.
reasons.fraud_risk: Unmatched neighbour signature and 140 m GPS gap support the customer; delivery scan, offline camera and prior claims add doubt. Repeat claims alone are not proof.
reasons.refund_claim_supported: The evidence is mixed: the carrier says delivered, but the signer is unverified; under a conservative policy this sits just below even.

reasons.claim_handling: High-value claim with conflicting evidence (GPS 140 m off, unmatched signer vs. repeat claims, missing footage and manager reply) calls for a carrier trace without paying yet, or gathering more evidence.
reasons.fraud_risk: Evidence cuts both ways; claim history and unverified statements raise doubt while GPS and signer mismatch support the customer: roughly even.
reasons.refund_claim_supported: GPS offset and unmatched signer lend some support, but carrier delivery record, missing manager confirmation and no camera log leave the claim unproven.

ui_dependence: A reference fact sets a refund cap and a constraint requires a carrier investigation above it, which changes the handling step relative to a general reading of the evidence.
